provenance.note: One rotation phase of the treatment. Planting and harvest events come from the stacked generator output, assigned to this phase by the plot ids in the Century package; planting amounts are still the generator's prior fills (prior_filled). Plantings, harvests and alfalfa cuttings the operation logs lack, including all of 2014, are filled from plot_system.csv and the cutting samples. Harvests take russell_harvest_lookup.csv (harvest_lookup_row: the site's own samples for corn and tomato, the shared harvest lookup for the rest), alfalfa cuttings leave the stand alive, cover crops and the 2008 and 2009 sudangrass go wholly to litter, and the 1993 sudangrass uniformity crop is cut for hay. No irrigation comes from the generator; it follows the rules below. Events no record gives are tagged provenance_class imputed, or assumed where they rest on a stated reading of the paper or package (the inches irrigation and the 80 mm wheat on its midpoint date, the 1999 tomato dates, compost years without an analysis), as described in runs/russell_ranch/events_treatments/README.md; they are filled in the order given in tools/event_prep/README.md. Fertilization is rebuilt from the package; a season with no record, of a crop the treatment fertilizes in at least half its seasons, copies the treatment's nearest same-crop season with records (a fertilization gap). A corn season with no N record takes Tautges et al. 2019's amounts: 56 kg N/ha starter and 180 kg N/ha of ammonium sulfate sidedress. Corn and tomato irrigation follows Tautges et al. 2019 instead of the generator: 33.6 in (853.44 mm) a season, 17.6 in in 1995 and 43.5 in in 2004, the paper's "mm" read as inches, applied to the soil in equal events of at most 150 mm timed from the monitoring irrigation product near Russell Ranch; 2013 and 2014 take the average, imputed. The file starts with the 1993 sudangrass uniformity crop, grown on every plot before the experiment: irrigated with the monitoring product's median irrigated F16 (corn, sorghum or sudan) season, 440.2 mm, on the sudangrass schedule (equal soil events of at most 150 mm from planting), unfertilized, and cut for hay (the lookup's hay row). Sudangrass, for which the paper gives nothing, takes the monitoring product's median irrigated F16 (corn, sorghum or sudan) season on the same schedule, imputed. Wheat irrigation follows Tautges et al. 2019's rule for the irrigated wheat systems instead of the generator: 80 mm per year at the season midpoint, applied to the soil, none in 1995, 1998, 2000, 2005 and 2008-2012, and 80 mm, imputed, in 2013 and 2014. The paper gives the rule for IWF and IWF+N only; this system's wheat is irrigated the same way, imputed. Tillage events are the operations Tautges et al. 2019 describe, one event each, timed and sized from medians of the monitoring tillage product within 25 km of Russell Ranch, 2016-2023 (calibration:runs/russell_ranch/events_treatments/monitoring_tillage_near_russell.csv), except that the herbicide incorporation passes the package logs (operations_pesticides.csv) keep their dates and the wheat straw disking comes before August, as the paper has it.
